description: An investor wants to allocate TotalInvestment amount of money between the telecom and healthcare industries. The amount invested in telecom should be at least MinTelecomHealthcareRatio times the amount invested in healthcare and should not exceed MaxTelecomInvestment. The investment in telecom yields TelecomInterestRate, while the investment in healthcare yields HealthcareInterestRate. The objective is to maximize the total profit from the investments.

TotalInvestment.definition: Total amount of money available for investment

MinTelecomHealthcareRatio.definition: Minimum ratio of telecom investment to healthcare investment

TelecomInterestRate.definition: Interest rate earned from telecom investments

HealthcareInterestRate.definition: Interest rate earned from healthcare investments

objective.description: "The goal is to maximize the total profit from the telecom and healthcare investments"
